title: C.D. NDE 2328
content: I went out of my body. Saw the doctors around working on me during surgery. I went through a tunnel really fast. I was in a wonderful light. I saw a bridge. Across the bridge were people I knew who had died, like my father who had died less than a year before this. He was so happy to see me and said, 'Hi Mija.' There was light around them. Other family members were all smiling at me. He was so proud for them to see me. I was happy to be there. Then after a while, a voice said I had to go back. It wasn't my time. I had things to do. My dad's face dropped. He looked sad. I said I didn't want to go back. I was crying. Then like an instant. I went back through the tunnel and I was back in my body. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1978 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Surgery-related Other during surgery of blood clot in my head I was in surgery with a blood clot in my head. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I felt love and warmth around me. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was with those I recognized. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Time went so fast. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The colors were so beautiful. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't think so. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes The colors were so pretty, and I went through it so fast. Did you see any beings in your experience? Sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes On the bridge were my family some I didn't recognize. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It felt warm. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Loved and happy to be there. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Remembered many past events I learned that those who died around me went to a better place and were okay. Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Christian Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I know God is real. What is your religion now? Moderate Christian Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I know God is real. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Unidentifiable voice Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Sensed their presence Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I can feel if a person is good or bad. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes How good it felt to be in the light. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I feel like I can sense dead spirits around me sometimes. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I saw my dad was okay. And I always wonder what it is I was supposed to do. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I never tell anyone this as an adult. Recently my cousin told me that I had told my mom when I woke up after the surgery - that I told her I saw her mother. And I guess she told her family. But it was never discussed with me. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I felt a sense of peace. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No
